Usage:  circleci feedback <message> [flags]

Flags:
      --function string   Function the report is about, or the name you looked for (e.g. "setup-vercel")
  -h, --help              help for feedback
      --jq string         Process values from the response using jq syntax
      --json              Output as JSON
      --tool string       CLI command or MCP tool the feedback is about (e.g. "run get")
      --type string       Kind of report: missing_function (no Function does what you needed) or function_gap (a Function falls short)
